usage_rules.primary_action: Use Accent (Neon Lime) for the main CTA button text or background depending on contrast.
usage_rules.gradients: FORBIDDEN. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures only.

grid_system.landing_hero: flex flex-col items-start justify-center min-h-[80vh] max-w-4xl mx-auto

buttons.primary: bg-foreground text-background hover:bg-foreground/90 h-12 px-8 text-lg font-medium rounded-full transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-border text-foreground hover:bg-muted h-12 px-8 text-lg font-medium rounded-full

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-border focus:border-foreground focus:ring-0 rounded-none px-0 py-4 text-xl placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50 transition-colors
inputs.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground mb-2 font-mono

cards.style: bg-card border border-border p-6 md:p-8 rounded-sm hover:border-foreground/20 transition-colors

visual_enhancers.noise: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
2. OVERRIDE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to use the specific colors defined in 'colors.palette'. Set borderRadius to '0.25rem' (sm).
3. NO GRADIENTS: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use the noise texture defined in 'visual_enhancers' for the main background.
4. TYPOGRAPHY FIRST: The design relies on font size and weight contrast. Do not add unnecessary icons or decorations.
5. ANIMATION: Use 'framer-motion' for the 'Scan Progress' page. It should look like a terminal executing commands line by line.
6. REPORT LAYOUT: The Audit Report should look like a technical document or a manifesto, not a dashboard. Use the 'Bento' grid logic.
7. FORMS: The input form should feel like a conversation. One question at a time or a very clean vertical list with massive spacing.
8. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
universal_guidelines: Do not use 'Inter' for Headings. Use 'Outfit'.
Do not use purple or teal. Use Neon Lime (#CCFF00) for accents.
Do not center everything. Use asymmetry.
Dark mode is the default preference, but support light mode via class strategy.
